branches.title: The Necromancer
branches.description: A routine patrol leads you toward something forbidden. Whatever is happening in that alley should not exist.

branches.title: Innocence
branches.description: A quiet night ends in sirens and accusations. Everything you say - or don't - may decide your fate.

branches.title: Oathbound
branches.description: A crown is about to be placed upon a prince's head. You are the only one who hears it protest.

branches.title: Continuance
branches.description: The world has refused to end. You stand among the mechanisms holding it in place.

branches.title: Votes
branches.description: The results are clear. The consequences are not. At dawn, the decision becomes reality.

branches.title: Substitute
branches.description: Your key works. Your life looks right. Something about it feels deeply wrong.

branches.title: Broadcast
branches.description: You have been transmitting into silence for years. Tonight, something answers.

branches.title: Key
branches.description: The artifact has chosen someone again. This time, it chose you.

branches.title: Residuals
branches.description: Recovery was declared complete. The paperwork disagrees with reality.

branches.title: Apology
branches.description: The system has already said it was sorry. You must decide what that means.

branches.title: Continuance: Ascend
branches.description: Reality survived because you did. Now it must decide how much of you it needs. [Continuance - You bound yourself as the final Anchor]
branches.requirements: You replace the Anchors. Reality holds — while you exist.

branches.title: Continuance: Eternal
branches.description: The world was preserved at a cost. What remains is the weight of forever. [Continuance - You sacrificed yourself to sustain the Anchors]
branches.requirements: The world endures forever. You do not.

branches.title: Continuance: Mercy
branches.description: The world was allowed to end. What followed was not absence, but the quiet work of completion. [Continuance - You shut down the Anchors]
branches.requirements: The Anchors fall. The world finally ends — gently.

branches.title: Oathbound: Loyalty
branches.description: You chose stability over truth. The crown still screams — just quieter now. [Oathbound - You destroyed the archived records and continued enforcing loyalty]
branches.requirements: The prince rules. The curse sleeps, not gone. Peace holds — barely.

branches.title: Ashfall
branches.description: Your future was calculated before you noticed the system existed. Tonight, it decides you are no longer necessary.

branches.title: Singular
branches.description: You were never meant to decide alone. One place. One moment. Every choice folds back onto itself.
